art_note: Clean lifestyle and product imagery, though standard e-commerce presentation holds back the highest luxury tier.
desc_en: Elevate the dining experience with this set of placemats from DAZMOND. Crafted from a polyester fabric with a linen-like feel, they combine durability with a refined aesthetic. The design features a polished graphic motif in dark and golden tones, ideal for setting a sophisticated atmosphere. Each piece is meticulously made to order, ensuring an unmatched standard of distinction in every detail.
desc_es: Eleve la experiencia en la mesa con este juego de manteles individuales de la casa DAZMOND. Confeccionados en tejido de poliéster de tacto similar al lino, combinan durabilidad con una estética refinada. El diseño presenta un motivo gráfico depurado en tonos oscuros y dorados, ideal para definir una atmósfera sofisticada. Cada pieza se elabora meticulosamente a pedido, asegurando un estándar de distinción inigualable en cada detalle.
